title: Presentarsi e parlare del proprio lavoro
intro: Oggi impari a presentarti, a dire che lavoro fai e a spiegare cosa stai facendo in questo periodo. Ripassi il present simple e il present continuous, la -s della terza persona e le domande con do e does. È la base di ogni primo incontro con un cliente o un collega.
goals: Presentarti in modo chiaro in 30 secondi
Descrivere il tuo ruolo, la tua azienda e le tue mansioni
Scegliere tra present simple e present continuous
Non dimenticare la -s della terza persona
Fare e capire domande con do e does

grammar.title: Present simple e present continuous, la -s e le domande con do e does
explainIt: Il present simple descrive cose che sono sempre vere, abitudini e routine. Esempi: I work in Milan. She starts at nine. Lo usiamo con parole come always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day, on Mondays. Si forma con il verbo base: I work, you work, we work, they work.

Con he, she e it il verbo prende la -s: he works, she manages, it runs. Ci sono tre casi speciali. I verbi in -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o prendono -es: she watches, he does, it fixes. I verbi con consonante più y cambiano in -ies: she studies, he tries. Il verbo have diventa has: he has. Questa -s è l'errore più comune degli italiani, perché in italiano il verbo cambia in modo diverso.

Il present continuous descrive qualcosa che succede adesso o in questo periodo, e che è temporaneo. Si forma con am, is o are più il verbo in -ing: I am working on a new website. We are testing the checkout. Lo usiamo con now, at the moment, currently, this week. In italiano è come 'sto lavorando'. Ma attenzione: l'inglese lo usa anche per periodi più lunghi, come I'm working on a big project this month.

Alcuni verbi di solito non si usano nel continuous: sono verbi di stato come know, like, want, need, understand, have (per possesso). Si dice I know the answer, non I am knowing. Si dice I need the file, non I am needing the file.

Domande e negazioni del present simple usano do e does. Do you work from home? Does she manage the team? Con does il verbo torna senza -s: Does she work here? Non Does she works. Nelle negazioni: I don't work on Fridays. He doesn't know. Nel continuous invece si inverte: Are you working today? Is he using the new tool? Per le domande con parola interrogativa: Where do you work? What does she do? What are you doing now?
explainEn: We use the present simple for things that are always true, habits and routines. For example: I work in Milan. She starts at nine. We often use it with always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day and on Mondays. The form is the base verb: I work, you work, we work, they work.

With he, she and it we add -s: he works, she manages, it runs. There are three special cases. Verbs ending in -s, -sh, -ch, -x and -o take -es: she watches, he does, it fixes. Verbs with a consonant and y change to -ies: she studies, he tries. The verb have becomes has. This -s is the most common mistake for Italian speakers.

We use the present continuous for something happening now or around now, and for temporary situations. The form is am, is or are plus the verb with -ing: I am working on a new website. We are testing the checkout. We use it with now, at the moment, currently and this week. We can also use it for longer periods, like I'm working on a big project this month.

Some verbs are not usually used in the continuous: they are state verbs, like know, like, want, need, understand and have for possession. We say I know the answer, not I am knowing. We say I need the file, not I am needing the file.

Questions and negatives in the present simple use do and does. Do you work from home? Does she manage the team? After does the verb has no -s: Does she work here? Not Does she works. In negatives: I don't work on Fridays. He doesn't know. In the continuous we change the order: Are you working today? Is he using the new tool? Questions with a question word: Where do you work? What does she do? What are you doing now?

dialogue.title: Meeting a new client
dialogue.context: Luca incontra Emma, responsabile marketing di una nuova azienda cliente. Si presentano e parlano del loro lavoro prima della riunione.

lines.name: Emma
lines.en: Hi, you must be Luca. I'm Emma, the marketing manager at Northwind.
lines.it: Ciao, tu devi essere Luca. Sono Emma, la responsabile marketing di Northwind.

lines.name: Luca
lines.en: Nice to meet you, Emma. Yes, I'm Luca. I'm a web developer and I specialise in accessibility.
lines.it: Piacere, Emma. Sì, sono Luca. Sono sviluppatore web e sono specializzato in accessibilità.

lines.name: Emma
lines.en: Interesting. Do you work for an agency?

lines.name: Luca
lines.en: No, I'm self-employed. I work with small and medium businesses, mainly in Italy and the UK.
lines.it: No, lavoro in proprio. Lavoro con piccole e medie imprese, principalmente in Italia e nel Regno Unito.

lines.name: Emma
lines.en: That sounds busy. What are you working on at the moment?
lines.it: Sembra impegnativo. A cosa stai lavorando in questo momento?

lines.name: Luca
lines.en: I'm building an online shop for a clothing brand. I'm also testing a website with a screen reader.
lines.it: Sto costruendo un negozio online per un marchio di abbigliamento. Sto anche testando un sito con uno screen reader.

lines.name: Emma
lines.en: Great. And what does a normal day look like for you?
lines.it: Ottimo. E com'è una tua giornata normale?

lines.name: Luca
lines.en: I usually start at eight. First I check my emails, then I write code. In the afternoon I speak to clients.
lines.it: Di solito comincio alle otto. Prima controllo le mail, poi scrivo codice. Nel pomeriggio parlo con i clienti.

lines.name: Luca
lines.en: Yes, most days. I go to a coworking space on Wednesdays. And you? How many people are in your team?
lines.it: Sì, quasi tutti i giorni. Il mercoledì vado in uno spazio di coworking. E tu? Quante persone ci sono nel tuo team?

lines.name: Emma
lines.en: Eight. I manage the content and the social media, and my colleague Tom looks after the website.
lines.it: Otto. Io gestisco i contenuti e i social, e il mio collega Tom si occupa del sito.

lines.name: Luca
lines.en: So I'll work with Tom on the project?

lines.en: Yes. He doesn't have much experience with accessibility, so he's really looking forward to learning from you.

lines.name: Luca
lines.en: Perfect. I'm happy to train him. Shall we start the meeting?
lines.it: Perfetto. Sono contento di formarlo. Cominciamo la riunione?

writing.taskIt: Scrivi una breve presentazione di te per una mail a un nuovo cliente, James. Di' come ti chiami, che lavoro fai, per chi lavori e qual è la tua specializzazione. Descrivi una tua giornata tipica in due o tre frasi con il present simple. Poi spiega a cosa stai lavorando in questo periodo con il present continuous. Chiudi dicendo che ti fa piacere collaborare con lui.
writing.taskEn: Write a short introduction of yourself for an email to a new client, James. Say your name, your job, who you work for and what you specialise in. Describe a typical day in two or three sentences using the present simple. Then explain what you are working on at the moment using the present continuous. Close by saying you are happy to work with him.
writing.model:
Subject: Introduction

Dear James,

Let me introduce myself. My name is Luca and I'm a web developer and accessibility consultant. I work for myself, and I mainly help small and medium businesses to build websites that everyone can use.

My day usually starts at eight. First I check my emails, then I write code or test pages with a screen reader. In the afternoon I speak to clients and plan the next steps.

At the moment I'm working on an online shop and I'm preparing an accessibility audit for another client.

I'm really happy to work with you on this project. Please let me know when you are available for a first call.

Best regards,
Luca

video.title: Le domande con do e does

say.text: Per fare domande al present simple si usa do o does. Con does il verbo torna senza la s, perché la s è già in does.
Do you work from home?
Does she work here?
Tre errori da evitare. Primo, dimenticare la s con she. Secondo, mettere la s dopo does. Terzo, usare il continuous con verbi come know e need.
She works here. Does she work here? I know the answer.
Ecco tre espressioni utili per descrivere il tuo ruolo. Usale quasi in ogni primo incontro.
I'm responsible for the front end of the site.
I deal with clients and project planning.
We specialise in accessibility audits.
Riepilogo. Per le routine usa il present simple. Per quello che succede ora usa il present continuous. Per le domande usa do e does, e ricordati la s con he, she e it.
What do you do? What are you working on at the moment?
